title: Implement POST command handler and article receiver
description:
Implement the POST command handler: respond 340 (send article), receive the dot-terminated article stream, parse headers and body, hand off to the validation pipeline. Respond 240 on success, 441 if posting not permitted, 44x on specific failures. Artifact: reader/src/session/commands/post.rs.

Acceptance:
- POST with no group selected returns 441 (posting not permitted) if operator has disabled it
- Article stream terminated by CRLF.CRLF is read completely before validation begins
- Article with no Newsgroups: header returns 441 with descriptive text
- Article larger than configured limit returns 441 with size-exceeded message
- Dot-unstuffing applied to article body before validation
